mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_PRCDOC_M ( PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, PRCDOC_CFY, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_NM, ATCT_NM, FNCLC_ID, DOC_TYP, DOC_PART_NO, RRD_CFY, MNTRG_YN, AUCR_YN, APRV_YN_CFY, APRV_STEP_CFY, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL), 0) +1 FROM GE_MP_PRCDOC_M), #{DIVS_CD}, #{PPCD}, #{PRCDOC_CFY}, #{PRCDOC_NO}, #{PRCDOC_NM}, #{ATCT_NM}, #{FNCLC_ID}, #{DOC_TYP}, #{DOC_PART_NO}, #{RRD_CFY}, #{MNTRG_YN}, #{AUCR_YN}, #{APRV_YN_CFY}, #{APRV_STEP_CFY}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_PRCDOC_M SET DIVS_CD = #{DIVS_CD}, PPCD = #{PPCD}, PRCDOC_NO = #{PRCDOC_NO}, PRCDOC_NM = #{PRCDOC_NM}, DOC_TYP = #{DOC_TYP}, DOC_PART_NO = #{DOC_PART_NO}, RRD_CFY = #{RRD_CFY}, ATCT_NM = #{ATCT_NM}, FNCLC_ID = #{FNCLC_ID}, MNTRG_YN = #{MNTRG_YN}, AUCR_YN = #{AUCR_YN}, APRV_YN_CFY = #{APRV_YN_CFY}, APRV_STEP_CFY = #{APRV_STEP_CFY}, REGPR_ID = #{REGPR_ID}, REGPR_NM = #{REGPR_NM}, RG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL}
UPDATE GE_MP_PRCDOC_M SET DLT_YN = 'Y' WHERE PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL IN(${CHK_ITEMS})
mapper.select: SELECT PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_NM, DOC_TYP, DOC_PART_NO, PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, ATCT_NM, FNCLC_ID, RRD_CFY, MNTRG_YN, AUCR_YN, APRV_YN_CFY, APRV_STEP_CFY, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_PRCDOC_M WHERE PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FRM1_M ( FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_OVER_JSON, FRM_CONS_JSON ) VALUES ( #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_OVER_JSON,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{FRM_CONS_JSON,jdbcType=CLOB} )
mapper.select:
SELECT PRCDOC_NO AS "절차서번호", PRCDOC_NM AS "절차서명",
ATCT_NM AS "점검지명",
FNCLC_ID||' ' AS "절차서기능위치", PRCDOC_RVSN_NO "LDM최종버젼", PRCDOC_RVSN_NO "서식최종버젼", TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "등록일", NVL(REGPR_NM, '없음') AS "등록자",
(SELECT count(*) FROM GE_MP_FRMID_M WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL) AS "DB갯수"
(SELECT count(*) FROM GE_MP_QR_M WHERE PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL) AS "QR갯수"
FROM GE_MP_PRCDOC_M A WHERE DLT_YN = 'N'
AND A.PPCD = #{PPCD}
AND A.PRCDOC_CFY = #{PRCDOC_CFY}
AND A.PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
AND A.PRCDOC_NM LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NM}||'%'
ORDER BY RG_DT DESC
